user_story: As a staff member, I want deleting a confirmed booking to return an error so that active reservations are protected.

positive.title: Verify error returned when attempting to delete a confirmed booking
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking.
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that confirmed bookings cannot be deleted.

negative.title: Verify behavior when attempting to delete an active booking without confirmation
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Select an active booking without confirmation.
Attempt to delete the active booking.
negative.expected_result: The active booking is deleted successfully and no error is displayed.

edge.title: Verify error when trying to delete a confirmed booking that is about to expire
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Select a confirmed booking that is close to its expiration time.
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that confirmed bookings cannot be deleted.
